execution.timing_scope: reference _score_fn or paired scorer call, including probability calculation and the same surrogate_gain reduction

memory.temporary_feature_bytes_definition: live float32 observation, latent, phi, psi, and base_logits tensors in one paired scorer call; excludes outputs and allocator-reserved memory

cohort_scale.basis: estimated from mean paired timing delta per scorer multiplied by the real 2 score calls per prefix case; not a full-cohort rerun

claim_boundary: Same-score common-subexpression optimization only. This is not SparseForest local maintenance, structural novelty, or a core contribution claim.
timing_context: potentially contaminated: benchmark ran concurrently with the source-dose pilot; do not use these timing values as clean evidence
